svg.title: Managed AI-agent swarm with protected platform and customer boundaries
svg.desc: A proposed platform architecture that keeps authority, spending limits, episode risk and pending effects in protected state across dynamic AI-worker replacement while preserving customer or partner enforcement.
svg.metadata: Source: Spherity GmbH. Executive Brief, page 12. CC BY 4.0. Original PDF vector geometry and embedded glyph outlines; crop includes all figure borders and connectors.
